subject: Court Closures and Limited Services
description: Order to Allow Grant County Circuit Court to Conduct Court Hearings in Harney County Circuit Court Due to Emergency Conditions [May 4, 2015, through May 8, 2015]
title: Oregon Chief Justice Order 2015-016 — Order to Allow Grant County Circuit Court to Conduct Court Hearings in Harney County Circuit Court Due to Emergency Conditions [May 4, 2015, through May 8, 2015]
text:
In the Matter of Grant County Circuit
Court Service Limits Because of
Emergency Conditions
CHIEF JUSTICE ORDER
No. 015-016
ORDER TO ALLOW GRANT COUNTY
CIRCUIT COURT TO CONDUCT COURT
HEARINGS IN HARNEY COUNTY CIRCUIT
COURT DUE TO EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
. I HEREBY ORDER, pursuant to ORS 1.002 AND 1.085(3), that:
1. Emergency conditions will exist in the Grant County Circuit Courthouse May 4, 2015,
through May 8, 2015, due to floor abatement and installation of new flooring.
(
2. Grant County Circuit Court shall conduct necessary court hearings at the Harney County
Circuit Court May 4, 2015, through May 8, 2015. The Harney County Circuit Courthouse
is located at 450 N. Buena Vista, #16, Burns, OR 97720.
3. All other court operations, including filing of documents, assisting the public, and
receipting monies, shall take place in a different part of the Grant County Circuit
Courthouse May 4, 2015, through May 8, 2015.
4. The court shall notify the following people and organizations of this change in operations
as soon as possible and in the manner that the Presiding Judge determines will give
sufficient notice:
• State Court Administrator
• State and local authorities
• Business partners of the court
• Oregon State Bar and local bar association
• State and local news media
5. This order takes effect immediately.
